name: ZERO Co., Ltd.
summary: ZERO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides vehicle transportation and maintenance services in Japan. It offers new and used vehicle transportation, and door-to-door transportation of private cars and motorbikes. The company also offers new, heavy vehicle, and other maintenance services; handling and vehicle inspection services at auto auction; car selection services; general cargo transportation services; and human resources services, including pick-up and dispatching services.
